answer: Response-cadence fingerprinting. Each agent identity must emit request timing consistent with a sonnet-like fixed meter: inter-arrival intervals within a narrow band, checked over sliding windows. New identities ramp in slowly, so a burst of accounts cannot synchronize a voyage of coordinated calls without drifting off-meter. Attackers must either slow each sock puppet to human cadence, multiplying wall-clock cost per identity, or pay for distinct traffic-shaping infrastructure on a reef of proxies.
